Added optional `with_none_set` query parameter to include a "None" option in the response
when there are specification sections without a specification set. The "None" option is
only included on the first page when `with_none_set=true` and when sections without sets exist.

To include specification sections in the recycle bin, add the `?is_recycle_bin=true` query parameter.

patch.summary: Bulk update for Specification Sets for a Project
patch.description:
Applies create, update, and delete operations for specification sets in a single request.
Include any of `creation_params`, `updation_params`, and `deletion_params` as needed.

Successful operations run in one database transaction. Valid rows are persisted even when other
rows in the same request fail validation.

When one or more rows fail validation, the response is **400 Bad Request** with
`error.details[0].reason_code` set to `VALIDATION_FAILED` and a `failures` object grouping errors
under `creation_failures`, `updation_failures`, and `deletion_failures` (see the `400` response schema).

creation_params.description: New sets to create. Use `key` to correlate validation errors in the response.

key.description: Client-supplied id for matching entries in `error.details[0].failures.creation_failures`.

position.description: Ordering position of the set within the project.

updation_params.description: Existing sets to update; failures are keyed by set `id` in the error payload.

name.description: Updated name of the specification set.

position.description: Updated ordering position of the set within the project.

data.description: List of specifications sets for current project

deletable.description: True if set does not have any related revisions or uploads

400.description: Bad Request — one or more create/update operations failed validation. Inspect `error.details[0].failures` for per-entity field messages (`*_error` keys).

schema.title: Specification Sets Bulk Validation Error
schema.description: Returned when PATCH bulk update fails model validation. Structure matches other specifications bulk endpoints (for example specification section divisions): grouped failures by operation with `VALIDATION_FAILED` in `details[0].reason_code`.

code.description: HTTP status equivalent in screaming snake case.

message.example: One or more validation errors occurred

details.description: Contains one object describing validation failures when `reason_code` is `VALIDATION_FAILED`.

message.example: One or more validation errors occurred
message.description: Localized message for this detail entry.

creation_failures.description: Map of client `key` from `creation_params` (stringified) to field errors. If `key` is omitted, the server uses the zero-based index of the item in `creation_params` as a string key.

additionalProperties.description: Keys are attribute names with an `_error` suffix (for example `name_error`, `position_error`, `date_error`).
Localized validation message for that field.

updation_failures.description: Map of specification set id (string) to field-level validation errors.

deletion_failures.description: Reserved for deletion validation; typically an empty object.
